```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(performance)
library(vegan)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

annot_master<-read.csv(here("Data", "cluster_and_ed50_data.csv")) #from phenotype_heatmap script
df_modeling <- annot_master %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("K_"), site), as.factor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(site))

k_cols <- paste0("K_", 3:15)
```

```{r}
#icra
icra<- df_modeling%>%
  filter(species == "icra")

#removing the odd samples.

ikm <- list()

for (i in 2:15) {
  k_var <- paste0("K_", i)
  
  if (!k_var %in% names(icra)) next
  
  # Drop empty factor levels for the K variable
  active_levels <- table(droplevels(as.factor(icra[[k_var]])))
  
  # Skip if K only has 1 group represented in this subset
  if (length(active_levels) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", k_var, "because it only contains 1 active factor level in the data."))
    next
  }
  
  # 
  form_base <- as.formula(paste("ED50 ~", k_var, "+ (1 | site)"))
  ikm[[paste0("ik", i, "m")]] <- lmer(form_base, data = icra, REML = TRUE)
}

#
all_models <- c(
  list("ispp_m" = ikm), 
  ikm
)

# 2. Extract metrics safely
master_model_table <- imap_dfr(all_models, function(model_obj, model_name) {
  
  # Safeguard: Skip elements that aren't actually fitted model objects
  if (is.list(model_obj) && !inherits(model_obj, "merMod")) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", model_name, "because it is a raw list, not a fitted model."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Safely extract performance metrics
  perf    <- tryCatch(model_performance(model_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  r2_vals <- tryCatch(r2(model_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Fallback to NA if extraction fails for a specific model
  aic_val <- if (!is.null(perf$AIC)) round(perf$AIC, 1) else NA
  bic_val <- if (!is.null(perf$BIC)) round(perf$BIC, 1) else NA
  r2_m    <- if (!is.null(r2_vals$R2_marginal)) round(r2_vals$R2_marginal, 3) else NA
  r2_c    <- if (!is.null(r2_vals$R2_conditional)) round(r2_vals$R2_conditional, 3) else NA
  
  data.frame(
    Model_Name      = model_name,
    AIC             = aic_val,
    BIC             = bic_val,
    Marginal_R2     = r2_m,
    Conditional_R2  = r2_c,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# 3. View sorted results
master_model_table <- master_model_table %>% arrange(AIC)
print(master_model_table)

###plot
library(ggeffects)

# 1. Change "ik5m" to whatever model won your AIC comparison
winning_model <- ikm[["ik3m"]] 

# 2. Extract model predictions for your specific K variable
# (Swap 'K_5' with whichever K matched your winning model)
predictions <- ggpredict(winning_model, terms = "K_3")

# 3. Plot the final relationship
ggplot() +
  # 1. Raw data points colored by site
  geom_jitter(data = icra, aes(x = K_3, y = ED50, color = site), width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # 2. Model fit prediction line (Added group = 1)
  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(x = x, y = predicted, group = 1), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  
  # 3. Model uncertainty confidence ribbon (Added group = 1)
  geom_ribbon(data = predictions, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = 1), alpha = 0.15) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Effect on ED50",
    x = "K=3 Value Assignment",
    y = "ED50 Response"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

```
